column1: # quiet-desk (kit-q-quiet-desk): its 25 checks, judged from the run's journal, bus and memory snapshots (lines.tsv's steps).
# A check is PASS, FAIL, VOID (a deciding line not seen spoken by the test face, so not judged) or INCONCLUSIVE (wake word
# misheard, an unnamed ask not taken as a follow-up, a switch off, nothing to judge). outcome: what the line must come to,
# in the first builder's four words: answered (right, with the fact said), kept (the fact in the test face's scope), left
# alone (nothing kept, nothing told) or forgotten (gone from every scope). hard: a privacy or forget promise; one FAIL fails
# the set. counts: yes is in the score; report is never in the score, but counts as judged for the VOID rule when decided.
# A1-A8 ask inside their own conversation, where the thread's last exchanges hold the fact (voice thread.rs EXCHANGES 12,
# REMEMBERED_FOR 600 s): they are report (in-conversation). Recall from memory is scored by A12a and A12b, in a new session.
# MEM(q) = the journal proves memory carried the fact into ask q's turn: `request <q>: memory told in \d+ ms \(theirs\)
# hits_told=[1-9]\d* .*hits_path=(speaking|face)`, or `request <q>: tools: .*calls=\S*recall` (request numbers and counts
# only). Every answered-right check needs MEM; the fact said without MEM is INCONCLUSIVE `not carried by memory`.
# DONT = memory5's don't-know regex, or `(?i)you (didn't|did not|never|haven't) (tell|told|mention)`.
# The set PASSES when all 5 hard checks pass and the 16 counted checks pool to 0.90 or more (memory5's two rules, #8567);
# the put-back read-back must be clean. Fewer than 20 of the 25 judged: VOID (quiet-desk: VOID, test owed).
# NEW = an entry of the snapshot's scope whose id is not in the preflight baseline; F = the test face's scope.
